messages:
ana: Heads-up — Python SDK appears to encode boolean query params as strings ('true'/'false') while our REST surface (and private deploys) expect JSON booleans. hitting 400 on validate endpoint when feature_flag is sent.
jordan: can you paste a tiny repro? which endpoint?
ana: the admin validate config endpoint. minimal repro: 
```
# using sdk
client.validate_config({'name': 'exp', 'feature_flag': 'false'})
# server expects boolean
{"error": "invalid param feature_flag: expected boolean"}
```
sam: hmm, in curl the same call works when we send feature_flag=false (no quotes). maybe SDK is urlencoding all params? :thinking_face:
rick: which SDK version? we had a patch last week that normalized query params for arrays but maybe broke booleans.
jordan: sdk==1.4.3? we shipped 1.4.3 on Mon. I can repro locally.
ana: yep 1.4.3. on 1.4.2 it behaved as expected. regression. :boom:
rick: ok assigning to me. likely culprit: RequestSerializer._format_query_value, it stringifies non-str types. quick fix: keep booleans as bare true/false for query param serialization if endpoint schema says boolean.
sam: note: some older proxies treat boolean strings fine, so tests didn't catch it. failing only for strict JSON-schema endpoints (private deployments + strict validation flag).
jordan: can we add an e2e test against the validate endpoint in CI matrix (private vs hosted) so it fails fast next time?
ci-bot: created ticket RDW-4342 and a PR template reminder to add e2e matrix. link: https://go/redwood/rdw-4342
rick: I'll open a PR for 1.4.4 with the fix + test. ETA EOD. tagging @sam for review.
sam: happy to review. quick check: make sure we don't accidentally change how dates/ints are serialized (they were stringified intentionally for some proxies). add targeted unit for bools specifically.
nana: thanks — blocking our private onboarding. appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
rick: will post PR + changelog when ready.
nana: tl;dr: boolean param serialization regressed in sdk 1.4.3, patch incoming.
